title: Practical Skills in HCI; Participatory Design Research Practicum (Kids Team)
description:
Students will meet a total of 8 times, for a combined experience consisting of in-depth seminar-style readings on participatory design, hands-on participation with KidsTeam (virtual), and the experience of co-leading and debriefing a session of their own.

Meeting dates are as follows: 01/26, 01/28, 02/02, 02/04, 02/09, 02/11, 02/16.
